q: What has keys but can't open a single lock?
The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
What runs but never walks, has a mouth but never talks, has a bed but never sleeps?
What gets wetter the more it dries?
I'm tall when I'm young and short when I'm old. What am I?
What has a head and a tail but no body?
What belongs to you, but everyone else uses it more than you do?
The person who makes me has no need of me; the person who buys me has no use for me; the person who uses me can neither see nor feel me. What am I?
